      { cyrillic: 'Ч', latin: 'Ch', greek: '', name: 'cheh', sound: 'ch as in church', type: 'consonant', frequency: 0.012 },
      { cyrillic: 'Ш', latin: 'Sh', greek: '', name: 'shah', sound: 'sh as in shell', type: 'consonant', frequency: 0.006 },
      { cyrillic: 'Щ', latin: 'Shch', greek: '', name: 'schah', sound: 'shch as in fresh cheese', type: 'consonant', frequency: 0.003 },
      { cyrillic: 'Ъ', latin: '', greek: '', name: 'tvyordiy znak', sound: 'hard sign (no sound)', type: 'modifier', frequency: 0.0004 },
      { cyrillic: 'Ы', latin: 'Y', greek: '', name: 'yery', sound: 'i as in bit, but deeper', type: 'vowel', frequency: 0.016 },
      { cyrillic: 'Ь', latin: '', greek: '', name: 'myahkiy znak', sound: 'soft sign (no sound)', type: 'modifier', frequency: 0.014 },
      { cyrillic: 'Э', latin: 'E', greek: '', name: 'eh', sound: 'e as in end', type: 'vowel', frequency: 0.003 },
      { cyrillic: 'Ю', latin: 'Yu', greek: '', name: 'yoo', sound: 'yu as in use', type: 'vowel', frequency: 0.006 },
      { cyrillic: 'Я', latin: 'Ya', greek: '', name: 'yah', sound: 'ya as in yard', type: 'vowel', frequency: 0.018 }
    ];

    // Russian phrases with translations and pronunciations
    const phrases = [
      { russian: "Доброе утро", english: "Good morning", pronunciation: "DOH-bro-ye OOT-roh" },
      { russian: "Спасибо", english: "Thank you", pronunciation: "spah-SEE-bah" },
      { russian: "Как дела?", english: "How are you?", pronunciation: "kahk dee-LAH" },
      { russian: "Меня зовут", english: "My name is", pronunciation: "mee-NYAH zah-VOOT" },
      { russian: "Я тебя люблю", english: "I love you", pronunciation: "ya tee-BYAH lyoo-BLYOO" },
      { russian: "Вот книга", english: "Here is a book", pronunciation: "voht KNEE-gah" },
      { russian: "Это дом", english: "This is a house", pronunciation: "EH-tah dohm" },
      { russian: "До свидания", english: "Goodbye", pronunciation: "dah svee-DAH-nee-ye" }
    ];
    
    // Russian poetry for pattern inspiration
    const poetryStructures = [
      { name: "Pushkin's Eugene Onegin", pattern: "iambic tetrameter with alternating feminine and masculine rhymes" },
      { name: "Mayakovsky's Staircase", pattern: "stepped arrangement with increasing line lengths" },
      { name: "Akhmatova's Quatrains", pattern: "four-line stanzas with abab rhyme scheme" },
      { name: "Blok's Symbolism", pattern: "heavily symbolic with alliterative patterns" }
    ];

    // Color schemes
    const colorSchemes = {
      traditional: {
        background: "#f9f7f1",
        primary: "#8b0000", // Dark red
        secondary: "#003153", // Dark blue
        highlight: "#ffd700", // Gold
        connection: "#553939",
        text: "#2d2d2d"
      },
      winter: {
        background: "#f0f8ff",
        primary: "#4682b4", // Steel blue
        secondary: "#708090", // Slate gray
        highlight: "#b0e0e6", // Powder blue
        connection: "#778899",
        text: "#2f4f4f"
      },
      modern: {
        background: "#f5f5f5",
        primary: "#444444", // Dark gray
        secondary: "#666666", // Medium gray
        highlight: "#cccccc", // Light gray
        connection: "#999999",
        text: "#333333"
      },
      imperial: {
        background: "#f9f2e7",
        primary: "#8b0000", // Dark red
        secondary: "#000000", // Black
        highlight: "#ffd700", // Gold
        connection: "#3c1414",
        text: "#1a1a1a"
      }
    };

    // Initialize the visualization
    let svg, width, height;
    let currentPattern = "cyrillic-latin";
    let currentDensity = 5;
    let currentColorScheme = "traditional";
    let tooltip;

    function initializeVisualization() {
      // Clear previous SVG if it exists
      d3.select("#container svg").remove();
      
      // Get container dimensions
      const container = document.getElementById("container");
      width = container.clientWidth;
      height = container.clientHeight;
      
      // Create SVG
      svg = d3.select("#container")
        .append("svg")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height);
        
      // Initialize tooltip
      tooltip = d3.select(".tooltip");
      
      // Generate the pattern
      generatePattern();
    }

    function generatePattern() {
      // Get colors from the selected scheme
      const colors = colorSchemes[currentColorScheme];
      
      // Clear previous pattern
      svg.selectAll("*").remove();
      
      // Set background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", colors.background);
      
      // Different pattern types
      switch(currentPattern) {
        case "cyrillic-latin":
          generateAlphabetConnectionPattern(colors);
          break;
        case "cyrillic-greek":
          generateGreekConnectionPattern(colors);
          break;
        case "phonetic":
          generatePhoneticPattern(colors);
          break;
        case "poetry":
          generatePoetryPattern(colors);
          break;
      }
    }

    function generateAlphabetConnectionPattern(colors) {
      // Create a seamless wallpaper pattern showing Cyrillic-Latin connections
      const tileSize = 200;
      const tilesX = Math.ceil(width / tileSize) + 1;
      const tilesY = Math.ceil(height / tileSize) + 1;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "alphabet-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Generate the base pattern
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 2; i++) {
        const letter = russianAlphabet[Math.floor(Math.random() * russianAlphabet.length)];
        if (!letter.latin) continue;
        
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 8 + Math.random() * 14;
        
        // Draw the Cyrillic letter
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
        
        // Draw the Latin equivalent with connection
        if (Math.random() > 0.5) {
          pattern.append("text")
            .attr("x", x + size)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("font-size", size * 0.8)
            .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
            .text(letter.latin);
          
          pattern.append("line")
            .attr("x1", x + size/2)
            .attr("y1", y - size/3)
            .attr("x2", x + size + size/4)
            .attr("y2", y - size/3)
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
            .attr("opacity", 0.3);
        }
      }
      
      // Add some phrases in random locations
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity / 2; i++) {
        const phrase = phrases[Math.floor(Math.random() * phrases.length)];
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", Math.random() * (tileSize - 100))
          .attr("y", Math.random() * tileSize)
          .attr("font-size", 7)
          .attr("fill", colors.text)
          .attr("opacity", 0.15)
          .text(phrase.russian);
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#alphabet-pattern)");
      
      // Create interactive elements on top
      const letterRadius = 20;
      const letterSpacing = 70;
      const startX = width / 2 - (letterSpacing * 3);
      const startY = height / 2;
      
      // Select letters that have strong Latin/Greek connections
      const featuredLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.latin && l.latin.length === 1).slice(0, 7);
      
      // Create nodes for each featured letter
      featuredLetters.forEach((letter, i) => {
        const angle = (i / featuredLetters.length) * Math.PI * 2;
        const radius = 150;
        const x = width/2 + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
        const y = height/2 + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
        
        // Create connection lines
        svg.append("path")
          .attr("d", `M${width/2},${height/2} Q${width/2 + Math.cos(angle) * radius/2},${height/2 + Math.sin(angle) * radius/2} ${x},${y}`)
          .attr("class", "letter-connection")
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("opacity", 0.6)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
        
        // Create letter node
        const letterGroup = svg.append("g")
          .attr("class", "letter-node")
          .attr("transform", `translate(${x},${y})`)
          .on("mouseover", function(event) {
            // Show tooltip
            tooltip.html(`
              <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
              Latin: ${letter.latin}<br>
              Greek: ${letter.greek || "N/A"}<br>
              Sound: ${letter.sound}
            `)
            .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
            .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
            .style("opacity", 1);
            
            // Highlight connections
            d3.select(this).select("circle")
              .transition()
              .attr("r", letterRadius * 1.2)
              .attr("fill", colors.highlight);
          })
          .on("mouseout", function() {
            // Hide tooltip
            tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            
            // Reset highlight
            d3.select(this).select("circle")
              .transition()
              .attr("r", letterRadius)
              .attr("fill", colors.primary);
          });
        
        letterGroup.append("circle")
          .attr("r", letterRadius)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.9);
        
        letterGroup.append("text")
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("dy", "0.3em")
          .attr("fill", "white")
          .attr("font-size", letterRadius)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      });
      
      // Add a central node
      svg.append("circle")
        .attr("cx", width/2)
        .attr("cy", height/2)
        .attr("r", 30)
        .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
        .attr("opacity", 0.9);
      
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", width/2)
        .attr("y", height/2)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.3em")
        .attr("fill", "white")
        .attr("font-size", 18)
        .text("Аа");
    }
    
    function generateGreekConnectionPattern(colors) {
      // Similar to alphabet pattern but focusing on Greek connections
      const tileSize = 220;
      const tilesX = Math.ceil(width / tileSize) + 1;
      const tilesY = Math.ceil(height / tileSize) + 1;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "greek-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Generate the base pattern with Greek connections
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 2; i++) {
        // Filter letters with Greek connections
        const greekLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.greek);
        const letter = greekLetters[Math.floor(Math.random() * greekLetters.length)];
        
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 10 + Math.random() * 16;
        
        // Draw the Cyrillic letter
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
        
        // Draw the Greek connection
        if (Math.random() > 0.5 && letter.greek) {
          pattern.append("text")
            .attr("x", x + size * 0.8)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("font-size", size * 0.7)
            .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
            .attr("font-style", "italic")
            .text(letter.greek.charAt(0));
          
          pattern.append("line")
            .attr("x1", x + size/2)
            .attr("y1", y - size/3)
            .attr("x2", x + size + size/4)
            .attr("y2", y - size/3)
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
            .attr("opacity", 0.3);
        }
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#greek-pattern)");
      
      // Create feature visualization
      // Mathematical pattern with Greek/Cyrillic letter relationships
      svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width/2}, ${height/2})`)
        .attr("opacity", 0.9)
        .call(g => {
          // Create a circular arrangement
          const radius = 200;
          const greekLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.greek);
          
          // Draw connective circles
          g.append("circle")
            .attr("r", radius)
            .attr("fill", "none")
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 1)
            .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3")
            .attr("opacity", 0.5);
          
          greekLetters.slice(0, 12).forEach((letter, i) => {
            const angle = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
            const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
            const y = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
            
            // Letter node
            g.append("circle")
              .attr("cx", x)
              .attr("cy", y)
              .attr("r", 25)
              .attr("fill", colors.primary)
              .attr("opacity", 0.8)
              .on("mouseover", function(event) {
                tooltip.html(`
                  <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                  Greek: ${letter.greek}<br>
                  Sound: ${letter.sound}
                `)
                .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
                .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
                .style("opacity", 1);
              })
              .on("mouseout", function() {
                tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
              });
            
            // Cyrillic letter
            g.append("text")
              .attr("x", x)
              .attr("y", y)
              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
              .attr("dy", "0.3em")
              .attr("fill", "white")
              .attr("font-size", 18)
              .text(letter.cyrillic);
            
            // Greek equivalent - smaller and to the side
            g.append("text")
              .attr("x", x + 20)
              .attr("y", y - 20)
              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
              .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
              .attr("font-size", 12)
              .attr("font-style", "italic")
              .text(letter.greek.charAt(0));
          });
        });
    }
    
    function generatePhoneticPattern(colors) {
      // Create phonetic-based pattern
      // Organize letters by sound types (vowels, consonants, etc)
      
      // Create background pattern
      const tileSize = 240;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "phonetic-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Group letters by type
      const vowels = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.type === 'vowel');
      const consonants = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.type === 'consonant');
      
      // Add vowels in one style
      vowels.forEach((letter, i) => {
        if (Math.random() > 0.5) return; // Skip some randomly
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 12 + Math.random() * 8;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      });
      
      // Add consonants in another style
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 3; i++) {
        const letter = consonants[Math.floor(Math.random() * consonants.length)];
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 8 + Math.random() * 10;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#phonetic-pattern)");
        
      // Add feature visualization - phonetic clustering
      const margin = { top: 100, right: 100, bottom: 100, left: 100 };
      const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
      
      // Create data structure for phonetic map
      const phonetics = [
        { group: "Vowels", letters: vowels },
        { group: "Plosives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["б", "п", "д", "т", "г", "к"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Fricatives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["в", "ф", "з", "с", "ж", "ш", "х"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Affricates", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["ц", "ч", "щ"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Nasals", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["м", "н"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Liquids", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["л", "р"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) }
      ];
      
      // Create a zoom-in visualization of phonetic relationships
      const phCluster = svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width/2}, ${height/2})`)
        .attr("opacity", 0.85);
      
      // Draw central circles for each phonetic group
      phonetics.forEach((group, i) => {
        const angleStep = (2 * Math.PI) / phonetics.length;
        const groupAngle = i * angleStep;
        const groupRadius = Math.min(innerWidth, innerHeight) * 0.25;
        const centerX = Math.cos(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        const centerY = Math.sin(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        
        // Group circle
        phCluster.append("circle")
          .attr("cx", centerX)
          .attr("cy", centerY)
          .attr("r", 35 + group.letters.length * 2)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
        
        // Group label
        phCluster.append("text")
          .attr("x", centerX)
          .attr("y", centerY - 30)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("fill", colors.text)
          .attr("opacity", 0.7)
          .attr("font-size", 12)
          .text(group.group);
        
        // Letter nodes for this group
        group.letters.slice(0, 7).forEach((letter, j) => {
          const letterAngle = groupAngle + (j - group.letters.length/2) * 0.2;
          const letterRadius = 35 + group.letters.length * 1.2;
          const x = centerX + Math.cos(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          const y = centerY + Math.sin(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          
          // Letter circle
          phCluster.append("circle")
            .attr("cx", x)
            .attr("cy", y)
            .attr("r", 15)
            .attr("fill", colors.primary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.7)
            .on("mouseover", function(event) {
              tooltip.html(`
                <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                Sound: ${letter.sound}<br>
                Type: ${letter.type}
              `)
              .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
              .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
              .style("opacity", 1);
            })
            .on("mouseout", function() {
              tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            });
          
          // Letter label
          phCluster.append("text")
            .attr("x", x)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("dy", "0.3em")
            .attr("fill", "white")
            .attr("font-size", 14)
            .text(letter.cyrillic);
        });
        
        // Connect to center
        phCluster.append("line")
          .attr("x1", 0)
          .attr("y1", 0)
          .attr("x2", centerX)
          .attr("y2", centerY)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
          .attr("opacity", 0.5)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
      });
      
      // Center node
      phCluster.append("circle")
        .attr("r", 25)
        .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
        .attr("opacity", 0.8);
      
      phCluster.append("text")
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")

    function generatePattern() {

    function generateAlphabetConnectionPattern(colors) {
      // Create a seamless wallpaper pattern showing Cyrillic-Latin connections
      const tileSize = 200;
      const tilesX = Math.ceil(width / tileSize) + 1;
      const tilesY = Math.ceil(height / tileSize) + 1;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "alphabet-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Generate the base pattern
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 2; i++) {
        const letter = russianAlphabet[Math.floor(Math.random() * russianAlphabet.length)];
        if (!letter.latin) continue;
        
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 8 + Math.random() * 14;
        
        // Draw the Cyrillic letter
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
        
        // Draw the Latin equivalent with connection
        if (Math.random() > 0.5) {
          pattern.append("text")
            .attr("x", x + size)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("font-size", size * 0.8)
            .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
            .text(letter.latin);
          
          pattern.append("line")
            .attr("x1", x + size/2)
            .attr("y1", y - size/3)
            .attr("x2", x + size + size/4)
            .attr("y2", y - size/3)
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
            .attr("opacity", 0.3);
        }
      }
      
      // Add some phrases in random locations
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity / 2; i++) {
        const phrase = phrases[Math.floor(Math.random() * phrases.length)];
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", Math.random() * (tileSize - 100))
          .attr("y", Math.random() * tileSize)
          .attr("font-size", 7)
          .attr("fill", colors.text)
          .attr("opacity", 0.15)
          .text(phrase.russian);
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#alphabet-pattern)");
      
      // Create interactive elements on top
      const letterRadius = 20;
      const letterSpacing = 70;
      const startX = width / 2 - (letterSpacing * 3);
      const startY = height / 2;
      
      // Select letters that have strong Latin/Greek connections
      const featuredLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.latin && l.latin.length === 1).slice(0, 7);
      
      // Create nodes for each featured letter
      featuredLetters.forEach((letter, i) => {
        const angle = (i / featuredLetters.length) * Math.PI * 2;
        const radius = 150;
        const x = width/2 + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
        const y = height/2 + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
        
        // Create connection lines
        svg.append("path")
          .attr("d", `M${width/2},${height/2} Q${width/2 + Math.cos(angle) * radius/2},${height/2 + Math.sin(angle) * radius/2} ${x},${y}`)
          .attr("class", "letter-connection")
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("opacity", 0.6)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
        
        // Create letter node
        const letterGroup = svg.append("g")
          .attr("class", "letter-node")
          .attr("transform", `translate(${x},${y})`)
          .on("mouseover", function(event) {
            // Show tooltip
            tooltip.html(`
              <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
              Latin: ${letter.latin}<br>
              Greek: ${letter.greek || "N/A"}<br>
              Sound: ${letter.sound}
            `)
            .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
            .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
            .style("opacity", 1);
            
            // Highlight connections
            d3.select(this).select("circle")
              .transition()
              .attr("r", letterRadius * 1.2)
              .attr("fill", colors.highlight);
          })
          .on("mouseout", function() {
            // Hide tooltip
            tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            
            // Reset highlight
            d3.select(this).select("circle")
              .transition()
              .attr("r", letterRadius)
              .attr("fill", colors.primary);
          });
        
        letterGroup.append("circle")
          .attr("r", letterRadius)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.9);
        
        letterGroup.append("text")
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("dy", "0.3em")
          .attr("fill", "white")
          .attr("font-size", letterRadius)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      });
      
      // Add a central node
      svg.append("circle")
        .attr("cx", width/2)
        .attr("cy", height/2)
        .attr("r", 30)
        .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
        .attr("opacity", 0.9);
      
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", width/2)
        .attr("y", height/2)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.3em")
        .attr("fill", "white")
        .attr("font-size", 18)
        .text("Аа");
    }
    
    function generateGreekConnectionPattern(colors) {

        pattern.append("text")

          .attr("fill", colors.primary)

        // Draw the Greek connection
        if (Math.random() > 0.5 && letter.greek) {
          pattern.append("text")

      svg.append("rect")

      svg.append("g")

            .attr("opacity", 0.5);
          
          greekLetters.slice(0, 12).forEach((letter, i) => {

            // Letter node
            g.append("circle")

              .attr("fill", colors.primary)
              .attr("opacity", 0.8)
              .on("mouseover", function(event) {
                tooltip.html(`
                  <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                  Greek: ${letter.greek}<br>

                `)

            // Cyrillic letter
            g.append("text")

              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")

              .attr("fill", "white")

            // Greek equivalent - smaller and to the side
            g.append("text")

              .attr("font-size", 12)
              .attr("font-style", "italic")
              .text(letter.greek.charAt(0));
          });
        });
    }
    
    function generatePhoneticPattern(colors) {

        pattern.append("text")

          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)

      });
      
      // Add consonants in another style

        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;

        const size = 8 + Math.random() * 10;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#phonetic-pattern)");
        
      // Add feature visualization - phonetic clustering
      const margin = { top: 100, right: 100, bottom: 100, left: 100 };
      const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
      
      // Create data structure for phonetic map
      const phonetics = [
        { group: "Vowels", letters: vowels },
        { group: "Plosives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["б", "п", "д", "т", "г", "к"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Fricatives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["в", "ф", "з", "с", "ж", "ш", "х"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Affricates", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["ц", "ч", "щ"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Nasals", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["м", "н"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Liquids", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["л", "р"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) }
      ];
      
      // Create a zoom-in visualization of phonetic relationships
      const phCluster = svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width/2}, ${height/2})`)
        .attr("opacity", 0.85);
      
      // Draw central circles for each phonetic group
      phonetics.forEach((group, i) => {
        const angleStep = (2 * Math.PI) / phonetics.length;
        const groupAngle = i * angleStep;
        const groupRadius = Math.min(innerWidth, innerHeight) * 0.25;
        const centerX = Math.cos(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        const centerY = Math.sin(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        
        // Group circle
        phCluster.append("circle")
          .attr("cx", centerX)
          .attr("cy", centerY)
          .attr("r", 35 + group.letters.length * 2)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
        
        // Group label
        phCluster.append("text")
          .attr("x", centerX)
          .attr("y", centerY - 30)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("fill", colors.text)
          .attr("opacity", 0.7)
          .attr("font-size", 12)
          .text(group.group);
        
        // Letter nodes for this group
        group.letters.slice(0, 7).forEach((letter, j) => {
          const letterAngle = groupAngle + (j - group.letters.length/2) * 0.2;
          const letterRadius = 35 + group.letters.length * 1.2;
          const x = centerX + Math.cos(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          const y = centerY + Math.sin(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          
          // Letter circle
          phCluster.append("circle")
            .attr("cx", x)
            .attr("cy", y)
            .attr("r", 15)
            .attr("fill", colors.primary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.7)
            .on("mouseover", function(event) {
              tooltip.html(`
                <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                Sound: ${letter.sound}<br>
                Type: ${letter.type}
              `)
              .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
              .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
              .style("opacity", 1);
            })
            .on("mouseout", function() {
              tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            });
          
          // Letter label
          phCluster.append("text")
            .attr("x", x)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("dy", "0.3em")
            .attr("fill", "white")
            .attr("font-size", 14)
            .text(letter.cyrillic);
        });
        
        // Connect to center
        phCluster.append("line")
          .attr("x1", 0)
          .attr("y1", 0)
          .attr("x2", centerX)
          .attr("y2", centerY)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
          .attr("opacity", 0.5)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
      });
      
      // Center node
      phCluster.append("circle")
        .attr("r", 25)
        .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
        .attr("opacity", 0.8);
      
      phCluster.append("text")
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.3em")
        .attr("fill", colors.text)
        .attr("font-size", 12)
        .text("Звуки");

      // Generate the base pattern

        // Create connection lines
        svg.append("path")

          .attr("opacity", 0.6)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
        
        // Create letter node

        letterGroup.append("circle")

    function generateGreekConnectionPattern(colors) {

        .attr("opacity", 0.9)
        .call(g => {

          const radius = 200;

            .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3")
            .attr("opacity", 0.5);
          
          greekLetters.slice(0, 12).forEach((letter, i) => {

            const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
            const y = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
            
            // Letter node
            g.append("circle")
              .attr("cx", x)
              .attr("cy", y)
              .attr("r", 25)
              .attr("fill", colors.primary)
              .attr("opacity", 0.8)
              .on("mouseover", function(event) {
                tooltip.html(`
                  <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                  Greek: ${letter.greek}<br>
                  Sound: ${letter.sound}
                `)
                .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
                .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
                .style("opacity", 1);
              })
              .on("mouseout", function() {
                tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
              });
            
            // Cyrillic letter
            g.append("text")
              .attr("x", x)
              .attr("y", y)
              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
              .attr("dy", "0.3em")
              .attr("fill", "white")
              .attr("font-size", 18)
              .text(letter.cyrillic);
            
            // Greek equivalent - smaller and to the side
            g.append("text")
              .attr("x", x + 20)
              .attr("y", y - 20)
              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
              .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
              .attr("font-size", 12)
              .attr("font-style", "italic")
              .text(letter.greek.charAt(0));
          });
        });
    }
    
    function generatePhoneticPattern(colors) {
      // Create phonetic-based pattern
      // Organize letters by sound types (vowels, consonants, etc)
      
      // Create background pattern
      const tileSize = 240;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "phonetic-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Group letters by type
      const vowels = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.type === 'vowel');
      const consonants = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.type === 'consonant');
      
      // Add vowels in one style
      vowels.forEach((letter, i) => {
        if (Math.random() > 0.5) return; // Skip some randomly
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 12 + Math.random() * 8;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      });
      
      // Add consonants in another style
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 3; i++) {
        const letter = consonants[Math.floor(Math.random() * consonants.length)];
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 8 + Math.random() * 10;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#phonetic-pattern)");
        
      // Add feature visualization - phonetic clustering
      const margin = { top: 100, right: 100, bottom: 100, left: 100 };
      const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
      
      // Create data structure for phonetic map
      const phonetics = [
        { group: "Vowels", letters: vowels },
        { group: "Plosives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["б", "п", "д", "т", "г", "к"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Fricatives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["в", "ф", "з", "с", "ж", "ш", "х"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Affricates", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["ц", "ч", "щ"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Nasals", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["м", "н"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Liquids", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["л", "р"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) }
      ];
      
      // Create a zoom-in visualization of phonetic relationships
      const phCluster = svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width/2}, ${height/2})`)
        .attr("opacity", 0.85);
      
      // Draw central circles for each phonetic group
      phonetics.forEach((group, i) => {
        const angleStep = (2 * Math.PI) / phonetics.length;
        const groupAngle = i * angleStep;
        const groupRadius = Math.min(innerWidth, innerHeight) * 0.25;
        const centerX = Math.cos(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        const centerY = Math.sin(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        
        // Group circle
        phCluster.append("circle")
          .attr("cx", centerX)
          .attr("cy", centerY)
          .attr("r", 35 + group.letters.length * 2)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
        
        // Group label
        phCluster.append("text")
          .attr("x", centerX)
          .attr("y", centerY - 30)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("fill", colors.text)
          .attr("opacity", 0.7)
          .attr("font-size", 12)
          .text(group.group);
        
        // Letter nodes for this group
        group.letters.slice(0, 7).forEach((letter, j) => {
          const letterAngle = groupAngle + (j - group.letters.length/2) * 0.2;
          const letterRadius = 35 + group.letters.length * 1.2;
          const x = centerX + Math.cos(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          const y = centerY + Math.sin(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          
          // Letter circle
          phCluster.append("circle")
            .attr("cx", x)
            .attr("cy", y)
            .attr("r", 15)
            .attr("fill", colors.primary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.7)
            .on("mouseover", function(event) {
              tooltip.html(`
                <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                Sound: ${letter.sound}<br>
                Type: ${letter.type}
              `)
              .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")

              .style("opacity", 1);
            })
            .on("mouseout", function() {
              tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            });
          
          // Letter label
          phCluster.append("text")
            .attr("x", x)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("dy", "0.3em")
            .attr("fill", "white")
            .attr("font-size", 14)
            .text(letter.cyrillic);
        });
        
        // Connect to center
        phCluster.append("line")
          .attr("x1", 0)
          .attr("y1", 0)
          .attr("x2", centerX)
          .attr("y2", centerY)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
          .attr("opacity", 0.5)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
      });
      
      // Center node
      phCluster.append("circle")
        .attr("r", 25)
        .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
        .attr("opacity", 0.8);
      
      phCluster.append("text")
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.3em")
        .attr("fill", colors.text)

    function generateAlphabetConnectionPattern(colors) {

        const letterGroup = svg.append("g")
          .attr("class", "letter-node")
          .attr("transform", `translate(${x},${y})`)
          .on("mouseover", function(event) {
            // Show tooltip
            tooltip.html(`
              <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
              Latin: ${letter.latin}<br>
              Greek: ${letter.greek || "N/A"}<br>
              Sound: ${letter.sound}
            `)
            .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
            .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
            .style("opacity", 1);
            
            // Highlight connections
            d3.select(this).select("circle")
              .transition()
              .attr("r", letterRadius * 1.2)
              .attr("fill", colors.highlight);
          })
          .on("mouseout", function() {
            // Hide tooltip
            tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            
            // Reset highlight
            d3.select(this).select("circle")
              .transition()
              .attr("r", letterRadius)
              .attr("fill", colors.primary);
          });
        
        letterGroup.append("circle")
          .attr("r", letterRadius)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.9);
        
        letterGroup.append("text")
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("dy", "0.3em")
          .attr("fill", "white")
          .attr("font-size", letterRadius)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      });
      
      // Add a central node
      svg.append("circle")
        .attr("cx", width/2)
        .attr("cy", height/2)
        .attr("r", 30)
        .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
        .attr("opacity", 0.9);
      
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", width/2)
        .attr("y", height/2)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.3em")
        .attr("fill", "white")
        .attr("font-size", 18)
        .text("Аа");
    }
    
    function generateGreekConnectionPattern(colors) {
      // Similar to alphabet pattern but focusing on Greek connections
      const tileSize = 220;
      const tilesX = Math.ceil(width / tileSize) + 1;
      const tilesY = Math.ceil(height / tileSize) + 1;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "greek-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Generate the base pattern with Greek connections
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 2; i++) {
        // Filter letters with Greek connections
        const greekLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.greek);
        const letter = greekLetters[Math.floor(Math.random() * greekLetters.length)];
        
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 10 + Math.random() * 16;
        
        // Draw the Cyrillic letter
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
        
        // Draw the Greek connection
        if (Math.random() > 0.5 && letter.greek) {
          pattern.append("text")
            .attr("x", x + size * 0.8)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("font-size", size * 0.7)
            .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
            .attr("font-style", "italic")
            .text(letter.greek.charAt(0));
          
          pattern.append("line")
            .attr("x1", x + size/2)
            .attr("y1", y - size/3)
            .attr("x2", x + size + size/4)
            .attr("y2", y - size/3)
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
            .attr("opacity", 0.3);
        }
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#greek-pattern)");
      
      // Create feature visualization
      // Mathematical pattern with Greek/Cyrillic letter relationships
      svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width/2}, ${height/2})`)
        .attr("opacity", 0.9)
        .call(g => {
          // Create a circular arrangement
          const radius = 200;
          const greekLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.greek);
          
          // Draw connective circles
          g.append("circle")
            .attr("r", radius)
            .attr("fill", "none")
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 1)
            .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3")
            .attr("opacity", 0.5);
          
          greekLetters.slice(0, 12).forEach((letter, i) => {
            const angle = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
            const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
            const y = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
            
            // Letter node
            g.append("circle")
              .attr("cx", x)
              .attr("cy", y)
              .attr("r", 25)
              .attr("fill", colors.primary)
              .attr("opacity", 0.8)
              .on("mouseover", function(event) {
                tooltip.html(`
                  <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                  Greek: ${letter.greek}<br>
                  Sound: ${letter.sound}
                `)
                .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
                .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
                .style("opacity", 1);
              })
              .on("mouseout", function() {
                tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
              });
            
            // Cyrillic letter
            g.append("text")
              .attr("x", x)
              .attr("y", y)
              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
              .attr("dy", "0.3em")
              .attr("fill", "white")
              .attr("font-size", 18)
              .text(letter.cyrillic);
            
            // Greek equivalent - smaller and to the side
            g.append("text")
              .attr("x", x + 20)
              .attr("y", y - 20)
              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
              .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
              .attr("font-size", 12)
              .attr("font-style", "italic")
              .text(letter.greek.charAt(0));
          });
        });
    }
    
    function generatePhoneticPattern(colors) {
      // Create phonetic-based pattern
      // Organize letters by sound types (vowels, consonants, etc)
      
      // Create background pattern
      const tileSize = 240;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "phonetic-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Group letters by type
      const vowels = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.type === 'vowel');
      const consonants = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.type === 'consonant');
      
      // Add vowels in one style
      vowels.forEach((letter, i) => {
        if (Math.random() > 0.5) return; // Skip some randomly
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 12 + Math.random() * 8;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      });
      
      // Add consonants in another style
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 3; i++) {
        const letter = consonants[Math.floor(Math.random() * consonants.length)];
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 8 + Math.random() * 10;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#phonetic-pattern)");
        
      // Add feature visualization - phonetic clustering
      const margin = { top: 100, right: 100, bottom: 100, left: 100 };
      const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
      
      // Create data structure for phonetic map
      const phonetics = [
        { group: "Vowels", letters: vowels },
        { group: "Plosives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["б", "п", "д", "т", "г", "к"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Fricatives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["в", "ф", "з", "с", "ж", "ш", "х"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Affricates", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["ц", "ч", "щ"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Nasals", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["м", "н"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Liquids", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["л", "р"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) }
      ];
      
      // Create a zoom-in visualization of phonetic relationships
      const phCluster = svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width/2}, ${height/2})`)
        .attr("opacity", 0.85);
      
      // Draw central circles for each phonetic group
      phonetics.forEach((group, i) => {
        const angleStep = (2 * Math.PI) / phonetics.length;
        const groupAngle = i * angleStep;
        const groupRadius = Math.min(innerWidth, innerHeight) * 0.25;
        const centerX = Math.cos(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        const centerY = Math.sin(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        
        // Group circle
        phCluster.append("circle")
          .attr("cx", centerX)
          .attr("cy", centerY)
          .attr("r", 35 + group.letters.length * 2)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
        
        // Group label
        phCluster.append("text")
          .attr("x", centerX)
          .attr("y", centerY - 30)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("fill", colors.text)
          .attr("opacity", 0.7)
          .attr("font-size", 12)
          .text(group.group);
        
        // Letter nodes for this group
        group.letters.slice(0, 7).forEach((letter, j) => {
          const letterAngle = groupAngle + (j - group.letters.length/2) * 0.2;
          const letterRadius = 35 + group.letters.length * 1.2;
          const x = centerX + Math.cos(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          const y = centerY + Math.sin(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          
          // Letter circle
          phCluster.append("circle")
            .attr("cx", x)
            .attr("cy", y)
            .attr("r", 15)
            .attr("fill", colors.primary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.7)
            .on("mouseover", function(event) {
              tooltip.html(`
                <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                Sound: ${letter.sound}<br>
                Type: ${letter.type}
              `)
              .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
              .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
              .style("opacity", 1);
            })
            .on("mouseout", function() {
              tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            });
          
          // Letter label
          phCluster.append("text")
            .attr("x", x)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("dy", "0.3em")
            .attr("fill", "white")
            .attr("font-size", 14)
            .text(letter.cyrillic);
        });
        
        // Connect to center
        phCluster.append("line")
          .attr("x1", 0)
          .attr("y1", 0)
          .attr("x2", centerX)
          .attr("y2", centerY)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
          .attr("opacity", 0.5)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
      });
      
      // Center node
      phCluster.append("circle")
        .attr("r", 25)
        .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
        .attr("opacity", 0.8);
      
      phCluster.append("text")
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.3em")
        .attr("fill", colors.text)
        .attr("font-size", 12)
        .text("Звуки");

      height = container.clientHeight;
      
      // Create SVG
      svg = d3.select("#container")
        .append("svg")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height);
        
      // Initialize tooltip
      tooltip = d3.select(".tooltip");
      
      // Generate the pattern
      generatePattern();
    }

    function generatePattern() {
      // Get colors from the selected scheme
      const colors = colorSchemes[currentColorScheme];
      
      // Clear previous pattern
      svg.selectAll("*").remove();
      
      // Set background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", colors.background);
      
      // Different pattern types
      switch(currentPattern) {
        case "cyrillic-latin":
          generateAlphabetConnectionPattern(colors);
          break;
        case "cyrillic-greek":
          generateGreekConnectionPattern(colors);
          break;
        case "phonetic":
          generatePhoneticPattern(colors);
          break;
        case "poetry":
          generatePoetryPattern(colors);
          break;
      }
    }

    function generateAlphabetConnectionPattern(colors) {
      // Create a seamless wallpaper pattern showing Cyrillic-Latin connections
      const tileSize = 200;
      const tilesX = Math.ceil(width / tileSize) + 1;
      const tilesY = Math.ceil(height / tileSize) + 1;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "alphabet-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Generate the base pattern
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 2; i++) {
        const letter = russianAlphabet[Math.floor(Math.random() * russianAlphabet.length)];
        if (!letter.latin) continue;
        
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 8 + Math.random() * 14;
        
        // Draw the Cyrillic letter
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
        
        // Draw the Latin equivalent with connection
        if (Math.random() > 0.5) {
          pattern.append("text")
            .attr("x", x + size)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("font-size", size * 0.8)
            .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
            .text(letter.latin);
          
          pattern.append("line")
            .attr("x1", x + size/2)
            .attr("y1", y - size/3)
            .attr("x2", x + size + size/4)
            .attr("y2", y - size/3)
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
            .attr("opacity", 0.3);
        }
      }
      
      // Add some phrases in random locations
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity / 2; i++) {
        const phrase = phrases[Math.floor(Math.random() * phrases.length)];
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", Math.random() * (tileSize - 100))
          .attr("y", Math.random() * tileSize)
          .attr("font-size", 7)
          .attr("fill", colors.text)
          .attr("opacity", 0.15)
          .text(phrase.russian);
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#alphabet-pattern)");
      
      // Create interactive elements on top
      const letterRadius = 20;
      const letterSpacing = 70;
      const startX = width / 2 - (letterSpacing * 3);
      const startY = height / 2;
      
      // Select letters that have strong Latin/Greek connections
      const featuredLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.latin && l.latin.length === 1).slice(0, 7);
      
      // Create nodes for each featured letter
      featuredLetters.forEach((letter, i) => {
        const angle = (i / featuredLetters.length) * Math.PI * 2;
        const radius = 150;
        const x = width/2 + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
        const y = height/2 + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
        
        // Create connection lines
        svg.append("path")
          .attr("d", `M${width/2},${height/2} Q${width/2 + Math.cos(angle) * radius/2},${height/2 + Math.sin(angle) * radius/2} ${x},${y}`)
          .attr("class", "letter-connection")
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("opacity", 0.6)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
        
        // Create letter node
        const letterGroup = svg.append("g")
          .attr("class", "letter-node")
          .attr("transform", `translate(${x},${y})`)
          .on("mouseover", function(event) {
            // Show tooltip
            tooltip.html(`
              <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
              Latin: ${letter.latin}<br>
              Greek: ${letter.greek || "N/A"}<br>
              Sound: ${letter.sound}
            `)
            .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
            .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
            .style("opacity", 1);
            
            // Highlight connections
            d3.select(this).select("circle")
              .transition()
              .attr("r", letterRadius * 1.2)
              .attr("fill", colors.highlight);
          })
          .on("mouseout", function() {
            // Hide tooltip
            tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            
            // Reset highlight
            d3.select(this).select("circle")
              .transition()
              .attr("r", letterRadius)
              .attr("fill", colors.primary);
          });
        
        letterGroup.append("circle")
          .attr("r", letterRadius)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.9);
        
        letterGroup.append("text")
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("dy", "0.3em")
          .attr("fill", "white")
          .attr("font-size", letterRadius)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      });
      
      // Add a central node
      svg.append("circle")
        .attr("cx", width/2)
        .attr("cy", height/2)
        .attr("r", 30)
        .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
        .attr("opacity", 0.9);
      
      svg.append("text")
        .attr("x", width/2)
        .attr("y", height/2)
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.3em")
        .attr("fill", "white")
        .attr("font-size", 18)
        .text("Аа");
    }
    
    function generateGreekConnectionPattern(colors) {
      // Similar to alphabet pattern but focusing on Greek connections
      const tileSize = 220;
      const tilesX = Math.ceil(width / tileSize) + 1;
      const tilesY = Math.ceil(height / tileSize) + 1;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "greek-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Generate the base pattern with Greek connections
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 2; i++) {
        // Filter letters with Greek connections
        const greekLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.greek);
        const letter = greekLetters[Math.floor(Math.random() * greekLetters.length)];
        
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 10 + Math.random() * 16;
        
        // Draw the Cyrillic letter
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
        
        // Draw the Greek connection
        if (Math.random() > 0.5 && letter.greek) {
          pattern.append("text")
            .attr("x", x + size * 0.8)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("font-size", size * 0.7)
            .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
            .attr("font-style", "italic")
            .text(letter.greek.charAt(0));
          
          pattern.append("line")
            .attr("x1", x + size/2)
            .attr("y1", y - size/3)
            .attr("x2", x + size + size/4)
            .attr("y2", y - size/3)
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
            .attr("opacity", 0.3);
        }
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#greek-pattern)");
      
      // Create feature visualization
      // Mathematical pattern with Greek/Cyrillic letter relationships
      svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width/2}, ${height/2})`)
        .attr("opacity", 0.9)
        .call(g => {
          // Create a circular arrangement
          const radius = 200;
          const greekLetters = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.greek);
          
          // Draw connective circles
          g.append("circle")
            .attr("r", radius)
            .attr("fill", "none")
            .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
            .attr("stroke-width", 1)
            .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3")
            .attr("opacity", 0.5);
          
          greekLetters.slice(0, 12).forEach((letter, i) => {
            const angle = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2;
            const x = Math.cos(angle) * radius;
            const y = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
            
            // Letter node
            g.append("circle")
              .attr("cx", x)
              .attr("cy", y)
              .attr("r", 25)
              .attr("fill", colors.primary)
              .attr("opacity", 0.8)
              .on("mouseover", function(event) {
                tooltip.html(`
                  <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                  Greek: ${letter.greek}<br>
                  Sound: ${letter.sound}
                `)
                .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
                .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
                .style("opacity", 1);
              })
              .on("mouseout", function() {
                tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
              });
            
            // Cyrillic letter
            g.append("text")
              .attr("x", x)
              .attr("y", y)
              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
              .attr("dy", "0.3em")
              .attr("fill", "white")
              .attr("font-size", 18)
              .text(letter.cyrillic);
            
            // Greek equivalent - smaller and to the side
            g.append("text")
              .attr("x", x + 20)
              .attr("y", y - 20)
              .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
              .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
              .attr("font-size", 12)
              .attr("font-style", "italic")
              .text(letter.greek.charAt(0));
          });
        });
    }
    
    function generatePhoneticPattern(colors) {
      // Create phonetic-based pattern
      // Organize letters by sound types (vowels, consonants, etc)
      
      // Create background pattern
      const tileSize = 240;
      
      // Create a pattern definition
      const defs = svg.append("defs");
      const pattern = defs.append("pattern")
        .attr("id", "phonetic-pattern")
        .attr("width", tileSize)
        .attr("height", tileSize)
        .attr("patternUnits", "userSpaceOnUse");
      
      // Group letters by type
      const vowels = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.type === 'vowel');
      const consonants = russianAlphabet.filter(l => l.type === 'consonant');
      
      // Add vowels in one style
      vowels.forEach((letter, i) => {
        if (Math.random() > 0.5) return; // Skip some randomly
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 12 + Math.random() * 8;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2 + Math.random() * 0.3)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      });
      
      // Add consonants in another style
      for (let i = 0; i < currentDensity * 3; i++) {
        const letter = consonants[Math.floor(Math.random() * consonants.length)];
        const x = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const y = Math.random() * tileSize;
        const size = 8 + Math.random() * 10;
        
        pattern.append("text")
          .attr("x", x)
          .attr("y", y)
          .attr("font-size", size)
          .attr("fill", colors.primary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25)
          .text(letter.cyrillic);
      }
      
      // Apply pattern to background
      svg.append("rect")
        .attr("width", width)
        .attr("height", height)
        .attr("fill", "url(#phonetic-pattern)");
        
      // Add feature visualization - phonetic clustering
      const margin = { top: 100, right: 100, bottom: 100, left: 100 };
      const innerWidth = width - margin.left - margin.right;
      const innerHeight = height - margin.top - margin.bottom;
      
      // Create data structure for phonetic map
      const phonetics = [
        { group: "Vowels", letters: vowels },
        { group: "Plosives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["б", "п", "д", "т", "г", "к"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Fricatives", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["в", "ф", "з", "с", "ж", "ш", "х"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Affricates", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["ц", "ч", "щ"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Nasals", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["м", "н"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) },
        { group: "Liquids", letters: consonants.filter(l => ["л", "р"].includes(l.cyrillic.toLowerCase())) }
      ];
      
      // Create a zoom-in visualization of phonetic relationships
      const phCluster = svg.append("g")
        .attr("transform", `translate(${width/2}, ${height/2})`)
        .attr("opacity", 0.85);
      
      // Draw central circles for each phonetic group
      phonetics.forEach((group, i) => {
        const angleStep = (2 * Math.PI) / phonetics.length;
        const groupAngle = i * angleStep;
        const groupRadius = Math.min(innerWidth, innerHeight) * 0.25;
        const centerX = Math.cos(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        const centerY = Math.sin(groupAngle) * groupRadius * 0.6;
        
        // Group circle
        phCluster.append("circle")
          .attr("cx", centerX)
          .attr("cy", centerY)
          .attr("r", 35 + group.letters.length * 2)
          .attr("fill", colors.secondary)
          .attr("opacity", 0.2)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5);
        
        // Group label
        phCluster.append("text")
          .attr("x", centerX)
          .attr("y", centerY - 30)
          .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
          .attr("fill", colors.text)
          .attr("opacity", 0.7)
          .attr("font-size", 12)
          .text(group.group);
        
        // Letter nodes for this group
        group.letters.slice(0, 7).forEach((letter, j) => {
          const letterAngle = groupAngle + (j - group.letters.length/2) * 0.2;
          const letterRadius = 35 + group.letters.length * 1.2;
          const x = centerX + Math.cos(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          const y = centerY + Math.sin(letterAngle) * letterRadius;
          
          // Letter circle
          phCluster.append("circle")
            .attr("cx", x)
            .attr("cy", y)
            .attr("r", 15)
            .attr("fill", colors.primary)
            .attr("opacity", 0.7)
            .on("mouseover", function(event) {
              tooltip.html(`
                <strong>${letter.cyrillic}</strong> (${letter.name})<br>
                Sound: ${letter.sound}<br>
                Type: ${letter.type}
              `)
              .style("left", (event.pageX + 15) + "px")
              .style("top", (event.pageY - 20) + "px")
              .style("opacity", 1);
            })
            .on("mouseout", function() {
              tooltip.style("opacity", 0);
            });
          
          // Letter label
          phCluster.append("text")
            .attr("x", x)
            .attr("y", y)
            .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
            .attr("dy", "0.3em")
            .attr("fill", "white")
            .attr("font-size", 14)
            .text(letter.cyrillic);
        });
        
        // Connect to center
        phCluster.append("line")
          .attr("x1", 0)
          .attr("y1", 0)
          .attr("x2", centerX)
          .attr("y2", centerY)
          .attr("stroke", colors.connection)
          .attr("stroke-width", 0.5)
          .attr("opacity", 0.5)
          .attr("stroke-dasharray", "3,3");
      });
      
      // Center node
      phCluster.append("circle")
        .attr("r", 25)
        .attr("fill", colors.highlight)
        .attr("opacity", 0.8);
      
      phCluster.append("text")
        .attr("text-anchor", "middle")
        .attr("dy", "0.3em")
        .attr("fill", colors.text)
        .attr("font-size", 12)
        .text("Звуки");

<html lang="en">
<head>

    #container {
      position: relative;

    }
    
    svg {
      width: 100%;

    .controls {
      position: absolute;

    .letter-connection {

    .tooltip {

      border: 1px solid #ddd;
      border-radius: 4px;
      padding: 10px;
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity 0.3s;

    select, button {

    h3 {
      margin-top: 0;
      font-size: 16px;

    .fade-text {

    input[type="range"] {

<body>
  <div id="container">

  <div class="controls">

      <option value="cyrillic-latin">Cyrillic-Latin Connections</option>
      <option value="cyrillic-greek">Cyrillic-Greek Connections</option>
      <option value="phonetic">Phonetic Relationships</option>
      <option value="poetry">Russian Poetry Structure</option>

    <label for="density">Pattern Density:</label>

      // Initialize on load
      initializeVisualization();
      
      function updateVisualization() {
        currentPattern = document.getElementById('patternType').value;

    // Define the Russian alphabet with connections to Latin and Greek
